full_prompt_en: A square painterly city scene shows a broad snowy evening boulevard, with pedestrians and golden lamps reflected across wet paving. The gray-blue sky fills the upper left with scattered white snowflakes. Beyond the street, a long stone building rises diagonally from the left toward a pointed roof near the center, then continues into darker facades along the right edge. Snow rests on its roofline and ledges, while small yellow windows and a bright ground-floor band puncture the cool masonry. Near the right of center, a tall black lamppost carries a warm glowing lantern above the crowd. Smaller lamps recede down the street, giving the avenue a rhythmic trail of light. In the middle distance, numerous figures in dark coats walk toward and away from the viewer; their faces remain indistinct at this scale. A line of red and dark cars runs along the right-hand roadway. On the left, a snow-dusted stone parapet and leafless trees border the sidewalk, guiding the eye back toward the distant lights. The foreground is dominated by glazed paving stones and thin snow cover. Long broken gold reflections from the lamps stretch vertically across blue-gray puddles, interrupted by dark joints and footprints. The snow keeps falling through the warm halos and colder sky, but the buildings and street remain legible in layered perspective. Painterly strokes soften people, vehicles, and masonry while preserving the strong dark silhouettes of poles and trees. The light comes chiefly from the lanterns and shopfronts, giving the wet ground its brightest notes; ambient dusk keeps the sky and architecture in subdued blue-gray. No signage can be read. The overall composition is spacious yet lively, balancing cold falling snow with warm reflected light and steady urban depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式城市景象呈现宽阔的雪夜大道，行人与金色路灯倒映在湿亮铺地上。灰蓝天空占据左上方，散布白色雪点。街道后方一排长石楼从左向中央附近的尖屋顶斜向升起，然后接到右边缘较暗的立面。屋顶线和凸檐覆雪，小小黄色窗光与明亮底层灯带穿透冷色石墙。中部偏右，一根高黑路灯托着在拥挤街道上发暖光的灯笼。更小的路灯向深处退去，为大道建立有节奏的光列。中景许多穿深色外套的人朝向或背向观者行走；这个尺度无法分辨他们的脸。右侧车道排列着红色与深色汽车。左侧，覆雪石栏和落叶树沿人行道展开，引导视线回到远处灯光。前景主要是有薄雪的湿亮铺石。路灯金色长倒影在蓝灰水洼中竖向延伸，被深色砖缝和脚印切断。雪继续落过暖光晕与较冷的天空，建筑和街道仍在层层透视中清楚可辨。绘画笔触柔化行人、汽车与石墙，却保留灯杆和树木有力的深色剪影。光主要来自路灯和店面，使湿地面出现最亮的点；黄昏环境光让天空与建筑保持压低的蓝灰色。标牌无法辨读。整体构图开阔而有生气，以寒冷落雪平衡暖色倒影和稳定的城市纵深。
style_prompt_en: Painterly urban imagery blends fine atmospheric particles with visible, softened brushwork. A cool gray-blue and charcoal base carries concentrated amber and gold light, and those warm accents repeat as broken vertical reflections across darker horizontal planes. Architecture is suggested through layered silhouettes and small illuminated marks rather than uniform hard-edged detail. Near surfaces carry more texture and elongated gleams; distant masses dissolve gradually into a hazy, low-contrast field. Directional points of warm light create halos, while cool ambient illumination holds the surrounding volumes together. Repetition of small lights establishes depth, and strong dark linear accents keep the composition legible through the haze. Edges vary from sharp structural strokes to blurred moving forms and soft atmospheric veils. The overall effect is nostalgic and luminous, with moisture, grain, and reflected light doing much of the spatial work.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式城市影像把细小大气颗粒与可见而柔化的笔触融合。冷灰蓝与炭色底调承托集中的琥珀和金色光，这些暖色重音又作为断续竖向倒影重复在较暗的水平面上。大形借层叠剪影和小块发光痕迹暗示，不靠处处等量的硬边细节。近处表面有更多肌理和拉长光泽，远处体块逐渐消融进低对比雾气。暖光点形成光晕，冷环境光把周围体积连成整体。小光点的重复建立纵深，强烈深色线性重音让构图在雾中仍清晰。边缘从锐利结构笔触变为模糊的移动形体及柔软大气薄幕。整体效果怀旧而发光，湿润、颗粒和反射光承担大量空间塑造。
theme_en: A snowy evening boulevard with pedestrians and lamplight reflected on wet pavement
theme_zh: 雪夜大道上行人与路灯倒映在湿亮铺地中
name: Yuriy Shevchuk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
